title: Minecart SMP
body:
Welcome to Minecart SMP a proudly Australian Owned, community-funded Minecraft server built for players of all ages! We're all about creating a safe, family-friendly space where creativity and collaboration thrive. Whether you're here to build, explore, or make new friends, you'll feel right at home in our welcoming and supportive community. Thanks to the generous support of our players, we’re able to deliver constant updates, new features, and smooth gameplay. Whether you're a seasoned player or just starting out, Minecart SMP offers a fun, evolving experience you can count on. Join today and be part of something special!

**Check Out Our Socials And Website:**
